item.title: Michele MacNeill Death Exposed Her Husband’s Murder Plot
item.description: Michele MacNeill died in 2007 while recovering from cosmetic surgery. Her daughters challenged the initial finding of natural causes, pushing for an investigation that uncovered her husband’s affair. Martin MacNeill was convicted of her murder in 2013.

item.title: Megan Trussell Family Disputes Suicide Ruling After Review
item.description: Megan Trussell was found dead in Boulder Canyon in February 2025. Authorities ruled her death a suicide, and an independent state review supported that conclusion. Her family continues to challenge the findings and the handling of the investigation.

item.title: Jon Garner Murder Trial Ended With His Wife Acquitted
item.description: Jon Garner was fatally shot in his Texas home in January 2018. His wife Sandra reported a masked intruder, but investigators charged her with murder. A jury acquitted her in 2019 after the defense challenged the evidence against her.

item.title: Haleigh Cummings Vanished From Home at Five Years Old
item.description: Haleigh Cummings disappeared from her Satsuma home in February 2009 while her father’s girlfriend was babysitting. Investigators questioned inconsistencies in the caregiver’s account. Authorities consider the disappearance an unsolved homicide, but Haleigh has never been found.
